name: Phantom
description: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.

abilities.name: Incorporeal
abilities.description: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.description: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Lingering Haunt
abilities.description: Countdown (1d6). When the Phantom is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom’s HP and immediately spotlight them.
